parsed.why: No active traveler-facing restrictions; anti-discrimination covers gender identity/expression, Pride and leadership signal acceptance. Gaps: no classified hate-crime system, enforcement incomplete, raw bias counts lack magnitude.

No trans-specific law, discrimination/hate-crime text includes gender identity, but documented street online hostility, Pride attacks, uneven prosecutions. Social hostility with thin practical recourse dominates.

Small principality: no trans criminalization or facility ban; visitor documents unaffected by missing marker change. Thin social record, Catholic/official hostility to LGBT, no gender-identity recourse: moderate.

Criminalisation underpins surveillance, raids, extortion, detention abuse, trans custody in men's prison, state calls reporting. No protections; organised targeting with severe consequences. Severe risk.

Strong traveler-facing protections: equality law and hate-crime cover gender identity, bathroom access protected, redress and guidance exist. Low-level violence reporting shows recourse, not campaign. Sparse rural scene.
